test_issubtype: test the issubtype function to check if a type is a subtype of another type
test_issubinstance: test the issubinstance function to check if data is an instance of a given type
create_datapipetype: create a _DataPipeType instance to save and compare type annotations for DataPipes
build_datapipemeta: build a DataPipe class using _DataPipeMeta metaclass with typed __iter__ return annotations
reforce_reinforce_type: reinforce the type of a DataPipe instance to restrict it to a subtype of the original type
